tasks.short: Develop and implement client care plans

steps.what: Review client needs, observations and current care arrangements
Discuss client goals, preferences and practical support needs
Develop appropriate behavioral management and care interventions within delegated authority
Write the client care plan in the case system
Explain the final care plan and agree its practical use
Implement the agreed support and adapt to the client's response

tasks.design: Use a native case-summary view and structured plan sections in the {OTHER} social-care case system. These remove navigation and repeated headings and demographics; the assistant chooses interventions, writes the individual plan and implements support within existing delegation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case context and repeated plan fields are spread across screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and plan templates may consolidate existing information.
tasks.still_hard: Interventions must fit the client's needs and the assistant's authority.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant notices distress, changing needs and a plan the client cannot realistically follow.
tasks.altitude: Less screen navigation leaves a small amount of time for practical support; clinical authority does not expand.

reach.role: Child, Family, and School Social Workers
reach.task: Contribute factual observations to care planning

evidence.claim: Native views and plan templates can reduce repeated retrieval and formatting, with no measured local time result.

assumptions: Boundary includes plan development, its actual written record, explanation and support implementation; no extra approval is invented. OTHER means the social-care case system.

The case team produces dated observations and current arrangements in existing records. The assistant checks client identifier, observation date, goals, chosen action and responsibility in s1-s4; retained retrieval12.75 and writing14 hours count capture and checking. Missing or stale fields are entered and checked manually.
Test native views and templates before code. Plan saving is an ordinary author save with no approval gate and no claimed saving for clicking save.
Visit notes and management reports are priced in task3754 once, rather than duplicated as a trailing record here.
unknowns: Existing plan template and delegated scope
Actual share of repeated demographic entry
research_questions: Can a native plan template remove repeated fields without constraining individualized support?

already_counted.description: Case review, individual plan writing, dialogue and delivery

incremental.description: Correct template sections and view mappings

approvals.approved_version: The actual questions and explanations given in this client discussion; changes are checked as spoken
The final written care plan and explanation given to this client; changes require renewed checking
The specific support intervention in the current circumstances within delegation; changed circumstances require reassessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R91.75 gross8.25 less1 upkeep gives7.25 net. Low: already good views leave only one repeated-entry hour removable, R99 and1 upkeep, net0. High: a compatible plan template removes four writing hours and one retrieval hour, R95 and1 upkeep, net4; all intervention judgement and delivery remain.

tasks.short: Keep client visit records and prepare management reports

steps.what: Collect visit facts and resolve missing or contradictory details
Draft records describing the client visit and its outcomes

loop.purpose: Turn worker-written visit notes into a structured narrative draft
loop.input: Checked visit source notes with client identifier, date, observations and stated actions
loop.output: Draft visit record with source links and unresolved gaps
loop.check: The assistant checks every assertion, speaker attribution, uncertainty and action against the notes; unsupported risk or diagnosis statements are removed
loop.stop: Ambiguous identity, missing sources or unsupported meaning stops drafting and the assistant writes manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Visit narrative varies, while fixed fields alone cannot preserve its meaning

steps.what: Correct the narrative and write the final record in the case file
Prepare management reports from the final visit records

tasks.design: Test the native {OTHER} case-system report template first and add a bounded draft from worker-written visit notes only where narrative retyping remains. Keep source capture, meaning correction and final record writing explicit, then reuse checked records in the existing management-report layout in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Workers retype narratives and copy checked information into report layouts.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded narrative drafting is available, although a local source-linked workflow still needs testing.
tasks.still_hard: An omitted qualification or invented risk statement can materially distort a case.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant distinguishes observation, client statement and professional interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Time can shift from repeated prose to checking that the record fairly represents the client.

reach.learn: Source attribution and minimum necessary reporting

evidence.claim: Attendi offers dictation that produces structured care reports or letters; this supports drafting capability, not a local time estimate.
The Somerset council pilot reported reduced administration for social workers; its population and self-reported result do not establish this task's saving.
The proposed source-note workflow and retained-time estimates are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is actual visit record and management-report preparation, not the visit conversation or report submission. Task3757 owns submission and supervisory discussion.

The assistant produces client identifier, visit date, observations, attributed statements, actions and gaps in s1, whose20 hours stay fully counted. s2 uses those notes, never a free transcript; absent or unreliable fields trigger manual writing.
The final author write in s3 and native report save in s4 need no self-approval gate. There is no automated commit, recording, report send, risk score or eligibility decision.
Native templates precede custom drafting. Source access, retention and staff consultation are resolved before using sensitive case notes.
unknowns: Available native templates and approved model environment
Whether existing notes are sufficient without duplicate note-taking
research_questions: Does source-note drafting save net time after unsupported claims and omissions are corrected?

already_counted.description: Source capture, draft review, final writing and management-report checking

incremental.description: Review failed drafts and maintain report-field mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R72.25 gross27.75 minus2 upkeep gives25.75 net. Low: complex visits require near-complete narrative rewriting and duplicate-note checks, retaining91 hours plus2 upkeep, net7. High: clear notes remove15 drafting hours and5 layout hours while all capture and final correction remain, R80 plus2 upkeep, net18.

tasks.short: Explain agency services in visits and meetings

steps.what: Check current agency services, requirements and procedures
Prepare the relevant information sheet for the visit or meeting
Provide the checked information sheet to individuals or the group
Visit homes or attend meetings and explain services in accessible language

tasks.design: Use a maintained {DOCS} service index and existing approved information sheets to shorten preparation. The assistant checks relevance, hands over the exact sheet and keeps the visit, travel, discussion and comprehension work human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Outdated copies and scattered service guidance slow preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native document index and reusable approved sheets may avoid repeat searching and layout.
tasks.still_hard: Clients may need explanation, interpretation or reassurance rather than another document.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant adapts the explanation to what the person understands without promising eligibility.
tasks.altitude: A small preparation saving can support more careful explanations; visit capacity is mostly unchanged.

evidence.claim: A maintained document index and approved sheets can shorten retrieval and preparation without automating advice.

assumptions: Boundary includes preparation, handout delivery and the actual home visit or group meeting, including travel. The resulting visit record is counted once in3754.

The agency guidance owner produces service name, effective date, contact route and procedural requirements in existing approved documents. The assistant checks those sources in s1 and selects suitable sections in s2; retained12 and7 hours include all selection and checking. Missing guidance goes to manual verification, not generated advice.
Try native document search and existing sheets before code. No eligibility inference, automated client send or routine extra record is introduced.
The1-hour upkeep allowance covers reporting stale references; central owners' existing policy publication work is not transferred or claimed as a saving.
unknowns: Current guidance ownership and accessible formats
research_questions: Do existing sheets remove actual preparation work while preserving comprehension?

already_counted.description: Source checking, sheet selection, handover and visit delivery

incremental.description: Check and flag stale document references

approvals.approved_version: The exact current information sheet and intended recipients; a changed sheet or audience requires checking again
The specific service explanation given in this discussion, checked against current guidance as spoken

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R94 gross6 less1 upkeep gives5 net. Low: already familiar guidance and accessible-format adaptation leave R99 plus1 upkeep, net0. High: a current index saves two retrieval hours and reusable sheets save two preparation hours, R96 plus1 upkeep, net3; visits and delivery retain75 hours.

tasks.short: Submit reports and discuss problems with a supervisor

steps.what: Review reports and prepare the specific issues for supervisory review
Submit the final report package to the superior
Review the report and problems with the supervisor

tasks.design: Use a native submission package in {DOCS} or the {OTHER} case system, with the assistant checking the exact report and recipient before a configured {EMAIL} send. Keep supervisory discussion human; report authorship is already priced in3754.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report attachments, versions and recipients are assembled again for routine internal submissions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native shared-document links and a checked submission action can replace attachment assembly and addressing.
tasks.still_hard: The supervisor and assistant must resolve uncertainty and practical consequences.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant brings context that a report alone cannot convey.
tasks.altitude: Less package handling leaves a little more time to discuss difficult cases.

reach.role: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers
reach.task: Present factual case issues at supervision

evidence.claim: Native document links and a checked internal send can replace manual attachment handling; savings depend on a real current send.

assumptions: Boundary is report submission preparation, actual internal transmission and supervisory discussion.3754 owns original visit-report writing, so it is not counted again.

The assistant produces report version, case identifier, recipient and permitted access scope in s1 from the finished report and verifies them there. Its20 retained hours include capture and final send authorization. Missing or inconsistent fields force manual assembly and submission.

Try native document sharing and send configuration before custom integration. The send consumes only the authorized immutable report version; a changed report or recipient cancels release. Failures return to the assistant and are covered by upkeep.

The10-hour send baseline is actual attachment selection, addressing and transmission, not an ordinary save. Where reports are already available in the supervisor's native view, remove this opportunity rather than claiming a saving.
No new supervision minutes or trailing record are introduced.
unknowns: Whether a real manual submission occurs or the supervisor already has native access
research_questions: How much current submission time remains after using native links and keeping final-version checks?

already_counted.description: Package checking, authorization and supervisory discussion

incremental.description: Resolve delivery failures and correct recipient mappings

approvals.approved_version: The exact final report version, recipient and access scope checked in s1; any change voids authorization
